description.text: Major Course Advanced Management Macroeconomics Management Economics Marketing Management Strategic Management for Enterprises Organizational Behavior, Management Information System China: Culture& Enterprises Accounting Project Management Financial Management Business and Administrative Communication Logistics Management Development and Management of Human Resources E-Commence and Internet Marketing International Trade and Finance Duration: 2 academic years

duration.text: The Business Administration at Wuhan University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4722 USD/per year ￥ 34000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, who haven’t broken laws, are required to have master degree.
